name: Mercado da Alegria
description: Visit this charming urban bazaar in the picturesque Passeio Alegre garden. Browse stalls of artisanal cheeses, traditional sausages, and handcrafted items for a perfect Sunday stroll.
longDescription:
The Mercado da Alegria is an urban market event held in Porto's Passeio Alegre Garden. This edition on October 25, 2026, focuses on food and artisanal products, offering a selection of local produce and handcrafted goods. It serves as a platform for small producers and crafters to present their work directly to the public.

Visitors can expect a relaxed Sunday atmosphere, suitable for a leisurely exploration of the stalls. The market features a range of food items, including regional cheeses and cured meats, alongside various handmade crafts. The outdoor setting of the Passeio Alegre Garden provides a pleasant backdrop for browsing.

Entry to the Mercado da Alegria is free, and visitors are welcome to walk in. The Passeio Alegre Garden is accessible via bus routes serving the Foz do Douro area. It is a family-friendly event.
